test_results.database_migration: schema v5 to v6 passed with backup and integrity checks

security_findings: Resume parsing is explicit, local, bounded and review-only; attaching a document does not parse it.
No candidate facts were accepted for the user during implementation.
Original local documents and application data remain in ignored storage and were not staged.
The staged-file audit found no private documents, databases, runtime artifacts, credentials or personal local paths.
No account access, submission, scheduling, paid API, remote inference or public visibility was used.
outstanding_issues: Actual resume fact proposals require explicit user review before they can affect the candidate profile.
The optional trained embedding provider could not be benchmarked because its runtime and model are not installed locally; no model download was authorized.
The synthetic evaluation measures ranking behavior and does not estimate hiring probability.
